title: Capacity and measure approximations for Schrödinger operators
summary: We prove that logarithmic capacity convergence for phase-union spectra of quasi-periodic Schrödinger operators in the zero Lyapunov exponent regime is robust, requiring only continuity of the potential. Let $S^+(p/q)$ denote the union, over the phase, of the spectra at rational frequency $p/q$. We show that if the Lyapunov exponent vanishes on the spectrum $Σ(α)$ at an irrational frequency $α$, then for every sequence $p_n/q_n\toα$, the logarithmic capacities $Cap(S^+(p_n/q_n))\longrightarrow Cap(Σ(α)).$ We also prove convergence of the corresponding harmonic measures.
